Method of Attack: Installs via cron jobs to download and execute shell scripts from Pastebin, delivering a Monero cryptocurrency miner and a rootkit component; uses rootkit to hide cryptojacking activity, files, and network traffic; employs self-propagation via SSH and exploits CVE-2019-1003001 in Jenkins
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2019-3396 server-side template injection vulnerability in Confluence
Downloading and executing shell scripts from Pastebin URLs
Indicators of Compromise: Cron job entries executing shell scripts from hxxps://pastebin.com/raw/60T3uCcb and hxxps://pastebin.com/raw/rPB8eDpu
Use of rootkit compiled with GCC
Exploitation activity from an IP address in Romania dropping Dofloo malware
GandCrab ransomware dropped on vulnerable Confluence instances
